title: Paired t-test for a within-person change
summary: The mean change when the same people are measured twice (after minus before), with a t interval on the differences.
pinned_defaults: R: paired = TRUE with after first, so the difference is after minus before. R 4.4 removed paired = TRUE from the formula interface.
Python: ttest_rel (paired), after first. ttest_ind on the same columns is the unpaired test.
_uncontrolled_before_after: A paired t-test on one group measures change, not the effect of whatever happened between the two measurements. Without a control group, regression to the mean, secular trends and repeated testing all produce change on their own.
